description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLicenseAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, implementing CRUD API endpoints for managing employee license data in the Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for each API operation (get, list, create, update, delete), with detailed validation rules, request handling, and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing employee license data, including operations to retrieve, list, create, update, and delete licenses, with validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee license by employee number and license ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all licenses for a specific employee, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new license record for an employee based on the provided data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee license record with new data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified employee licenses identified by their IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Internal method that handles creation or update of an EmployeeLicense entity based on request data.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the employee number parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a license.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a license.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting licenses.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Internal method returning validation rules for license body data during create/update.
